alt_text: ZYCLOPS holds a single triangular cream tortilla chip above a small gold bowl of dark dip. He studies it with absurd concentration, one eyebrow slightly lifted. Close medium composition at a cafe table. Text: THE DIP. HE BROUGHT CHIPS.

title: This is fine

alt_text: ZYCLOPS sits perfectly composed at a little cafe table holding a cream mug. Three small stylized ochre flames are burning at the far edges of the room. He wears a faint knowing smile, eye half-lidded. Original composition, clean minimal background. Text: THIS IS FINE. THE COFFEE IS STILL WARM.

title: Copium
caption: house blend. no questions.

caption: he looked. there was nothing. he checked again.
alt_text: ZYCLOPS peeks around a broad dark curtain, one hand pulling it aside, the same single eye and familiar face clearly visible. Beyond the curtain is a completely empty ivory space. His gold eyebrow is raised with quiet suspicion. Text: NOTHING TO SEE. HE CHECKED.

caption: one eye. no idea. consistent as always.
alt_text: ZYCLOPS front facing with both palms raised in a restrained shrug, head tilted slightly, one broad gold eyebrow lifted. Friendly bemused smirk Text: ONE EYE. NO IDEA.

caption: the search continues. the evidence does not.
